Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: todolist (todo.blonskyi.dev) is a personal to-do list app. This page explains, specifically, what happens to your data when you connect your Google Calendar.
Privacy.accessBody: When you connect Google Calendar, todolist requests permission only to create, update, and delete the specific calendar events it creates on your behalf (the "calendar.events" scope). It never reads, lists, or otherwise uses any other event already on your calendar, and it never accesses any other Google data - not your calendar settings, other calendars, free/busy information, email, or files.
Privacy.purposeBody: Connecting Google Calendar lets you push a copy of a to-do list - its title and a checklist of its tasks - into your primary Google Calendar as a single all-day event, so its due date shows up alongside your other events. Sync only happens when you click "Sync to Google Calendar" for a specific list. todolist never reads Google Calendar data back, and never syncs anything automatically.
Privacy.storageBody: Your Google access and refresh tokens are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before being stored in todolist's own database. They are never transmitted to, or shared with, any third party, and are never used for advertising or profiling.
Privacy.retentionBody: Tokens are kept until you disconnect Google Calendar in Settings or delete your todolist account. Disconnecting revokes todolist's access at Google and deletes the stored tokens; calendar events created by earlier syncs stay in your Google Calendar. An event stays there until you remove it yourself, or until the corresponding list is deleted in todolist, which removes the matching event automatically.
Privacy.revokeBody: You can disconnect Google Calendar at any time from Settings in todolist. You can also revoke access directly from your Google Account, at:
Privacy.sharingBody: todolist does not sell, rent, or share your Google user data with any third party. It is used only to provide the Calendar sync feature described above.
Privacy.changesBody: This policy may be updated as the app changes. Any change affecting how Google user data is handled will be reflected here, with the date above updated accordingly.
